_comment: Repos whose CI cannot run (private repos, GitHub Actions billing off). For these, `gh pr merge` of a CONTENT-ONLY PR is accepted when `record-local-gate` recorded a green local run at the PR head. A repo without an entry here gets no such path. gate = commands run in order in a fresh clone of the PR head; contentPaths = the files a content PR may touch (glob: ** crosses directories, * stays inside one); codePrs: true = a PR with other files may also merge, but only with a TL verification marker for its head.
